name: This Is Worthless
look: Two stacked panels from Gravity Falls. Top: cartoon hands hold up a blank sheet of paper, with the subtitle "Woah." Bottom: Dipper Pines, in his white and blue pine tree cap, grins widely while holding the paper out, with the subtitle "This is worthless!"
use: Something looks exciting at first glance and turns out to be useless. Whatever goes on the blank paper, like a tiny coupon, a fake prize or a pointless certificate, earns a cheerful "this is worthless!"
slots: the seemingly exciting thing, on the blank paper (top panel)
examples: Coupon: 5% off your next purchase of $500 or more
describe: cartoon kid holding a blank paper then saying it's worthless
boy in a pine tree hat smiling with a piece of paper
dipper from gravity falls says woah then this is worthless
hands holding up an empty sheet of paper cartoon
kid amazed by a note then happily calling it useless
origin: From the animated series Gravity Falls, with Dipper Pines examining a sheet of paper.
